story.title: My Story
story.left:
My development journey started with frontend and full-stack web development. Over time, I gained experience working with WordPress, React, Next.js, and modern content management systems.

Since joining {company} in June 2023, I've worked on building, migrating, and maintaining client websites — from converting Figma designs into responsive interfaces to setting up Sanity CMS and migrating WordPress websites.
story.right: As AI development tools evolved, I integrated Claude, Claude Code, and ChatGPT into my everyday workflow. Today, I combine hands-on engineering with AI-assisted development to work more efficiently, solve technical challenges, and deliver better digital experiences.
story.quote: My approach combines AI-powered productivity, clean code, practical problem-solving, and careful testing.
